title: photonics-helper: photonics, fiber-optics and nonlinear-optics helpers for Python
description: A Python library providing a stable foundation for photonics computation: type-safe units and constants, temporal/spectral grids, an auditable optical material database, and a suite of nonlinear-optics tools (GNLSE propagation, soliton and breather analysis, Raman response and noise, phase-matching diagnostics, chi-squared mixing, DBR/TMM stacks, FROG retrieval, structured light), validated against results from the literature.
